item.title: Winter cold slowly starting to creep back
item.description: Temperatures will be fluctuating over the next few days, with a cold Sunday followed by a warm-up on Monday and Tuesday, before winter air returns in the second half of the week.

item.title: Mild mode returns Monday, winter fights back Wednesday
item.description: This weekend will bring a cold snap followed by a mild week with temperatures climbing into the 50s and 60s, but a cold wave will return on Wednesday with temperatures dropping into the 30s and 40s and a chance of snow showers.
